record.body:
## Evidence

README.md lines 500-515 still describe four pytest processes and a -m tmux pass. -m tmux now collects nothing and exits 5.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix work-item fix-review-findings updates the README.
